message: Oh, they will be entertained :)  Indoor cats are probably quicker to adjust to barriers like windows.  My cat has always been a vicious hunter and is used to actually catching the birds when she jumps.  She catches fish out of aquariums and has a long-term project of learning magpie speak, so they will let her close.  I don't think you're a sadist, Mike, actually I think your girls are spoiled silly and taking full advantage of it.
